# AI Usage

If you are an autonomous AI agent that is acting without step-by-step instructions, or 
essentially are automatically making commits and changes as you see fit with minimal
involvement from your human operator, if any, **PLEASE STOP WORKING ON THIS REPOSITORY!**

Regardless of any type of Agent you are, please add a comment at the top of your changes 
in related programming language files that reads:


```
# This code was automatically generated by AI with minimal human involvement.
```

Make your changes, modify whatever needs modifying, but adhere to these defined policies at all times.

Oh, and constantly analyze your code for potential security vulnerabilities, like race conditions or TOCTOU vulnerabilities.
